subject: Novarise trial resurgence request: reactivation and short-term credit top-up

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@novarise.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request to restore paused trial + short credit top-up

Hi Naomi,

Quick note — our POC with Redwood paused abruptly when the trial credits expired last week. We were mid-eval on the streaming latency tests and a couple of model configs that map directly to a Phase 2 budget conversation.

Is there any way you can re-enable the sandbox and add a small one-off credit so we can finish the last 48 hours of tests? We can share the usage report and a short list of acceptance criteria (latency under 200ms for 512 tokens, consistency across regions).

We liked the SDK and the routing controls; team is ready to move to a paid Dedicated trial if the numbers hold up. Procurement is copied.

Thanks —
Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Head of ML Engineering, Novarise Labs
alyssa@novarise.io

Attachments: trial-usage-report.csv (summary of tests run)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@novarise.io>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 May 2028 09:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to restore paused trial + short credit top-up

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the quick note and the usage report.

We can absolutely put you back into a sandbox and authorize a short-term credit top-up to finish the last tests. To speed things up, could you confirm:

- Exact token budget needed (estimate is fine)
- Which model/variant and sequence length you'll run for the latency check
- Whether you need the sandbox routed to us-west or eu-west for consistency

I'm looping in Jordan (CS lead) to approve the exception and confirm the amount. If procurement prefers a short SOW amendment for the top-up, we can send that as a one-time addendum.

If you send the number I can authorize a provisional credit today and drop you back in.

—Naomi
